name: Spellcasting
description: Cast Cleric spells using Wisdom. You know 3 cantrips and prepare 4 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace your prepared spells. You can use a Holy Symbol as your spellcasting focus.

descriptions.2: Cast Cleric spells using Wisdom. You know 3 cantrips and prepare 5 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace your prepared spells. You can use a Holy Symbol as your spellcasting focus.
descriptions.3: Cast Cleric spells using Wisdom. You know 3 cantrips and prepare 6 spells of level 1 or 2. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace your prepared spells. You can use a Holy Symbol as your spellcasting focus.

name: Divine Order
description: You have dedicated yourself to a sacred role of your choice. Protector: trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor. Thaumaturge: you know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list, and you gain a bonus to Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1).

name: Divine Spark
description: As a Magic action, expend one Channel Divinity and target another creature you can see within 30 feet. Roll 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier. Restore that many Hit Points, or deal that much Necrotic or Radiant damage (Constitution save for half damage).

name: Turn Undead
description: As a Magic action, expend one Channel Divinity. Undead of your choice within 30 feet make a Wisdom save. On failure, they are Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute and try to move away from you. Ends on damage, your Incapacitation, or your death.

name: Disciple of Life
description: When a spell cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points, each creature healed regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast it equal to 2 + the slot level.

name: Life Domain Spells
description: You always have Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, and Lesser Restoration prepared. These spells do not count against your prepared spell choices.

name: Preserve Life
description: As a Magic action, expend one Channel Divinity. Divide 15 Hit Points among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet, including yourself. This cannot restore a creature to more than half its Hit Point maximum.
